sectionAwards.title: Distinguished Service in Photonics Award
sectionAwards.description: Recognizing exceptional individuals whose leadership, academic dedication, and mentorship have shaped Egypt's optics and photonics community across generations.
sectionAwards.eligibility: Senior faculty members, industry founders, and section advisors with sustained service to Egyptian scientific advancement.
sectionAwards.prize: Commemorative Section Plaque and Honorary Lifetime Local Section Membership.

sectionAwards.title: Outstanding Student Chapter of the Year Award
sectionAwards.description: Honoring the Optica Student Chapter in Egypt that demonstrates the highest impact in student recruitment, technical workshops, community outreach, and international engagement.
sectionAwards.eligibility: Active chartered Optica Student Chapters across Egyptian universities.
sectionAwards.prize: $1,000 USD Chapter Activity Grant and Featured Presentation at the Annual Section Kickoff.

sectionAwards.title: Emerging Photonics Researcher Award
sectionAwards.description: Celebrating early-career researchers and engineers within five years of their terminal degree who have published high-impact work or led pioneering deep-tech innovation in Egypt.
sectionAwards.eligibility: Young professionals, post-doctoral researchers, and assistant professors under 35 years of age.
sectionAwards.prize: Research Travel Subsidy ($750 USD) and Keynote Invitation at Egypt Photonics Day.

sectionAwards.title: Best Capstone and Thesis Award in Optics
sectionAwards.description: Annual national contest recognizing the most innovative bachelor capstone projects, master theses, and doctoral dissertations across Egyptian universities.
sectionAwards.eligibility: Graduating seniors and recent post-graduate alumni from Egyptian faculties of Engineering and Science.
sectionAwards.prize: Cash Prize, Publication Support, and Direct Mentorship for International Journal Submission.

globalFellowships.title: Optica Foundation Student Travel Grants
globalFellowships.description: Enabling Egyptian undergraduate and graduate students presenting accepted papers at Frontiers in Optics (FiO) or CLEO to travel and participate in-person.

globalFellowships.title: Siegman International School on Lasers Fellowship
globalFellowships.description: Fully funded fellowship sending one outstanding Egyptian laser physics or optics student each year to the world's most prestigious week-long laser summer school.

globalFellowships.title: Optica Women Scholars Award
globalFellowships.description: Multi-year scholarship awarded to promising female undergraduate and graduate students pursuing degrees in optics and photonics, accompanied by executive mentorship.

globalFellowships.title: Amplify Scholarship for Underrepresented Students
globalFellowships.description: Supporting talented optics and physics students overcoming geographic and socioeconomic obstacles to complete advanced photonic degrees.

elevations.title: Senior Member and Fellow Elevations
elevations.description: Optica Egypt actively guides and supports mid-career and senior Egyptian researchers through the international peer-review process to achieve Senior Member and Fellow milestones.

tiers.perks: International recognition, senior committee eligibility, and peer review leadership.
tiers.support: Section advisory committee provides reference letters, nomination packaging, and dossier review.

tiers.perks: Top 0.5 percent lifetime distinction in optics and photonics worldwide.
tiers.support: Coordinated endorsement from current Egyptian and international Fellows.
